description: TextStack MCP server — work with your TextStack reading library from Claude Desktop / Cursor / any MCP client. Search and read both the public catalog and the books you uploaded, ask grounded questions, manage highlights and vocabulary — and write conclusions back into a book so they are still there when you return. Speaks stdio or remote HTTP.
